meaning:
ἔκ-τρωμα, -τος, τό
(ἐκτιτρώσκω, to miscarry), [in LXX: Job.3:16, Ecc.6:3 (; also in Aq., Psa.58:9, Num.12:12 (נָפַל) * ;]
an abortion, an untimely birth (see Field, Notes, 179): 1Co.15:8.†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: of one born out of due time

elsewhere.note: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
